correctionNotes: Use Sony MDR-M1ST Crinacle GRAS 43AG-7 AutoEq as the measured baseline, not prose-only inference.

Yaxi PRO M-ST pad effect is not confirmed by a dedicated measurement here, so treat it as a pad/preference layer: reduce the strongest stock bass shelf and broad treble lift modestly rather than fully retargeting.
Keep headroom generous because the measured baseline has large low-shelf and treble boosts.
If Simon reports too lean bass after listening, restore part of the 105 Hz shelf before changing mids.
signature: Closed-back studio monitor variant using YAXI PRO M-ST pads. Stock MDR-M1ST has a Crinacle/AutoEq GRAS 43AG-7 measured Harman correction; Yaxi pads are reported/user-confirmed to change the sound substantially by improving comfort, low-frequency resolution, and perceived openness/clarity, so bass and treble correction should be kept slightly less aggressive than stock AutoEq.
source: AutoEq crinacle GRAS 43AG-7 Sony MDR-M1ST measured Harman correction; YAXI PRO M-ST product descriptions and community reports; user note that Yaxi pads make the sound substantially different from stock. No dedicated Yaxi-pad measurement confirmed.
